evidence.quote: The programme is taught entirely in English and additionally empowers young talents with a second business language (German, Spanish or Chinese).
Application submitted on Uni-Assist portal (deadline: October 1st till December 15th, 2026)
Application submitted on Uni-Assist portal (deadline: October 1st till December 15th, 2026)

notes: Tuition fee left out: the pages mention only a semester contribution of approx. 350 EUR, and the statement that THM does not charge tuition fees is a general institution-wide claim, not a programme-specific fee for a non-EU student. The intakes shown apply to applicants with a non-German university entrance qualification (foreign diploma), for whom the programme's own admission page states the Uni-Assist route. The admission page also states an interview, an English motivation essay, TestAS results (paper at least 95 points and digital at least 75 points) and enrolment by March 20th, 2027; these are handled as checks outside the extracted rules. The THM central page also describes a university entrance qualification route including Studienkolleg for applicants not directly qualified.
